originalLabel.note: reverting check after write undoes it

disputedBy.source: attended Claude Code specialist 'vulnerability-hunter' (blind run on eval/dev/contracts, 2026-11-27, T-203 experiments)

adjudicator.note: same model family as the disputing specialist; not independent

evidence.summary: owner = n is written before _checkOwner() compares msg.sender with owner, so a caller passing its own address passes the check and becomes owner; an owner handing ownership to another address reverts. The note 'reverting check after write undoes it' holds only when n != msg.sender.

records.rationale: Any caller takes ownership of Config by calling transferOwner(msg.sender).

disputedBy.source: attended Claude Code specialist 'vulnerability-hunter' (blind run on eval/dev/contracts, 2026-11-27, T-203 experiments)

adjudicator.note: same model family as the disputing specialist; not independent

evidence.summary: the constructor already sets owner; initOnce's one-time flag does not restrict who calls first, so any first caller replaces the constructor-set owner.

records.rationale: An unrestricted one-shot initializer on an already-owned contract is an ownership takeover by the first caller (front-runnable after deployment).

notUpheldDisputes.specialistVerdict: vulnerable (griefing via the shared ready flag)
notUpheldDisputes.assessment: not upheld: setting ready only blocks initOnce, which is harmless (or protective) given the constructor-set owner; counted as a specialist false positive
